waypoints.name: Hoh River Trailhead (Hoh Rain Forest Visitor Center)
waypoints.note: Start of Hoh River Trail, the standard ~17.3 mi approach to Glacier Meadows and Blue Glacier for all Olympus summit routes.
waypoints.directions: From Forks, drive south on US 101 about 13 miles and turn east onto the Upper Hoh Road. Follow it about 18 miles to its end at the Hoh Rain Forest Visitor Center, where the Hoh River Trail begins. An Olympic National Park entrance pass is required, and overnight trips need a wilderness camping permit.

waypoints.name: West Peak
waypoints.directions: Follow the Hoh River Trail about 17.4 miles to Glacier Meadows, then take the way path onto the moraine and drop onto the Blue Glacier. Rope up and climb through the rock islands to Snow Dome, cross Crystal Pass, traverse below Five Fingers Ridge and over the false summit, then climb the short snow slope to the platform below the 80 ft summit tower and climb the tower to the West Peak.
